answer: Each identity must string a unique pearl on its proof-of-work chain: the first pearl costs 5,000 iterations, each next pearl doubles the work, and the chain must reach at least 12 pearls before any reward is claimable. A lotus blooms only after the full chain is verified by the beacon; any skipped pearl invalidates the entire strand. whisper gossip among clones cannot share pearls because each pearl binds to the unique identity key—clones must each grow their own lotus from scratch, making a swarm of N identities cost N times the work, with exponentially rising marginal cost.
